title: Vanilla Haunting
description: Loosely ports Create Mod's haunting into a vanilla setting.
body:
## Drop items on a soul campfire to haunt them!
![Haunting 16 snowballs by dropping them in a soul campfire.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/908dfc6a72ab938f6aac37d55eedf6f552f91f28.png)
![Result: 16 ghast tears.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a36b0317bca070b49f52e5e20fdd235f8a5610ae.png)

## Add your own recipes!
Features a template and two recipes. Adding more recipes is as simple as duplicating the template, putting in the item required and result, and running `recipe_builder.py`.

![Snowball to ghast tear recipe.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cde07b629b06f9ca250dd27496b5968773a0925c.png)
![Recipe builder script.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dd278d5573f55ae37716d6fe2f38d33b6071abdd.png)

### Currently, item tags are not supported.
